stop_rule: Collect all128/arm; compare cumulative64,96,128 rates and timing. Report unresolved uncertainty at cap, including rare exposure/disruption strata. No deck tuning.
matching: Common seeds and rotations, identical pod and pilot; RNG paths diverge so not identical counterfactual games.
mulligans: All seats casual full-seven reshuffle only dysfunctional hands; no sculpting.
statistics: Paired four-seat whole-seed bootstrap95% intervals;128/arm can detect only substantial effects, not prove equivalence.
counterfactuals: War Cadence blocker/tax assessment is plausibility screening from observed public states, not causal card ablation.

measurement_definitions.basic: Additional GGS-created Dragon within2 own turns and net meaningful board/resources growth.
measurement_definitions.strong: 3 simultaneous GGS Dragons,15 ready evasive power,multiple productions inturn,compounding extra combat,or observed draw/Treasure continuation.
measurement_definitions.whole_board_threat: 20 unblocked attacking power,15 whole-board combat damage inownturn,or20 whole-board total damage inownturn after ignition; objective pressure proxy, not forecasted lethal.
measurement_definitions.strict_dragon_pressure: 20 ready flying power from GGS-created Dragons or15 GGS Dragon combat damage inone ownturn.
measurement_definitions.protection: Visible candidates are not verified castable; observed response plus commander preservation reported separately.
measurement_definitions.feedback: Attributed observed resource return followed by actual Dragon creation within2 ownturns; association not card-level causal proof.
